notes:
AniBox 1.15.1 (24 Nov 2026): ready for the phone app's first test.
- The QR code under Settings → Phone app (and the sync folder's library.json) now also carries the Shield's address in your home network when this PC knows it, because phones often can't find Windows names like the Shield's.
- The sync folder now carries your sound and subtitle languages, so the phone picks the same tracks as the PC.
- New "Copy as text" button next to the QR code, for the phone app's "Paste the code's text".
- Collections with the same title now always sort the same way (found by the Windows tests).
